annotations.title: VIN decoder: make, model, year, engine and plant from a VIN

description: Decode a 17-character vehicle identification number (VIN) with the US NHTSA vPIC database: make, manufacturer, model, model year, trim, body class, vehicle type, doors, drive, fuel and electrification, engine cylinders, displacement and horsepower, transmission, weight class and assembly plant, plus the check-digit test. Best for North American vehicles. Use for listings, insurance and fleet records. A malformed VIN is a 400, uncharged. Example: vin=1HGCM82633A004352. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

vin.description: 17-character VIN (letters I, O and Q never appear)

year.description: Optional model year, which helps decode older or partial VINs
